tasks.short: Develop and distribute patient information materials

steps.what: Develop newsletter or brochure content from checked information
Lay out newsletters and brochures for printing
Check accuracy, legibility and final print version
Print and distribute the approved materials

tasks.design: Configure a reusable print template in {DOCS} to place the representative's exact selected text and images. The representative still develops the message, checks the final proof and distributes the approved version; no generated medical advice is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual placement and repeated formatting consume time after the content is written.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can perform consistent layout from explicit fields.
tasks.still_hard: Clear accessible language, current facts and a readable printed result need human checking.
tasks.human_edge: The representative chooses what patients need to understand and recognises misleading wording.
tasks.altitude: Less page formatting; editorial and release responsibility stay with the representative.

evidence.claim: Template-based layout of approved copy is an E1 design from model knowledge; no digest source establishes patient-publication savings.

assumptions: Boundary is content development through physical distribution; clinical policy authoring is outside it.

The representative produces title, body copy, captions, image files, source dates, audience, paper size, quantity and distribution locations in s1. All 45 hours remain, including capture; missing or overflowing fields return to manual layout rather than automatic truncation.
Test native document templates before code. Only mechanical placement in s2 loses time, not writing, printing or delivery.
Allow four focal hours for template repairs and unusual layouts beyond routine proof checking.
research_questions: Does the template preserve complete copy and readable layout for representative long and short materials?

approvals.approved_version: Exact print file version, text, images, source dates and publication instructions; changes void approval
Exact approved print file, quantity and distribution locations checked in s3; any change requires another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus4 upkeep =16 net. High assumes repetitive manual layout; low assumes existing templates already remove it. Physical production and distribution retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train staff and volunteers in patient relations

steps.what: Provide consultation or training on patient relations and rights

tasks.design: Retain consultation, scenario discussion and feedback with the representative. Current guidance in {DOCS} supports the session without replacing discussion of patients' rights or referral of clinical questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff need contextual advice and practice, rather than information alone.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change removes consultation and teaching time in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive situations can involve conflicting expectations and professional boundaries.
tasks.human_edge: The representative tests understanding and helps staff handle difficult interactions respectfully.
tasks.altitude: Training and consultation responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Retaining live consultation and training is an E1 assessment from model knowledge, not a measured case.

assumptions: Boundary is consultation and training delivery; separate material publication is counted in its own task.
No structured classification or machine step is proposed.
Existing guidance and communication facilities remain in use; no custom build.
Zero additional upkeep because the process does not change.
research_questions: Which scenarios reveal gaps in escalation and patient-relations understanding?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Consultation and instruction remain counted; no speculative slide-writing share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach patients to use home care equipment

steps.what: Teach patients equipment use and observe their demonstration

tasks.design: Keep device-specific instruction, demonstration and teach-back in person. Approved instructions in {DOCS} support the encounter; equipment settings and prescribed treatment remain with authorised clinical staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reading instructions does not establish that a patient can use equipment safely.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated substitute removes observation and correction of actual use.
tasks.still_hard: Dexterity, comprehension, home circumstances and device differences affect safe use.
tasks.human_edge: The representative notices misunderstandings and escalates concerns beyond their competence.
tasks.altitude: No change to instructional responsibility or time is claimed.

reach.task: Identify patient difficulties during equipment teach-back

evidence.claim: Keeping equipment demonstration and observed teach-back human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is patient education within the representative's authorised competence, not prescription or device configuration.
No machine step or assumed structured competence flag is introduced.
Existing device instructions suffice; no software build is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the task and tools remain unchanged.
research_questions: Can patients demonstrate correct use and identify when to seek help after instruction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Demonstration, observation and correction remain fully human; no device runtime is counted as labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repetitive print layout while preserving sensitive consultation and practical patient teaching.
reach: Support communications staff with accessible print proofs
role.ambitious_version: A patient representative who makes information understandable and checks that people can act on it safely.
